main_text.p: Quædam incremento syllabico brevi, non præfigunt primam litteram thematis:
Quædam contrá, incremento (ut videtur) positione longo præfigunt:
πτάομαι, πέπτημαι, volo, volavi. Nam μν, πτ, poetis ancipitem faciunt.
Dicitur etiam promiscuè ἔκτημαι & κέκτημαι: utá

page.notes: Greek transcribed from a small, slightly blurred scan; several accents and breathings in the polytonic forms are uncertain and may differ from the printing. Lines marked with a dot or bullet at the left margin (e.g. "μνάομαι") are not separate notes. The final line is cut off at the foot of the page.
